graph.nodes: baseline keyframes, raw sequential frame poses, never optimized snapshot poses
graph.baseline_edges: one composite LK relative edge between adjacent keyframes
graph.auxiliary_edges: one native PnP relative edge per successful frozen pair
graph.information: frozen independent LK and auxiliary observation weights
graph.writeback: causal constant left correction on separate output after receipt; immutable historical outputs, no tracking/map/BA feedback

sparse250.selection: earliest first nonzero keyframe, next only if target RGB timestamp >= last selected timestamp + .25s; no GT and no runtime backfill
sparse250.pair_definition: selected target j always matched with original source j-1; not previous selected target

prefetch.source_rule: original source j-1 for every frozen eligible target j
prefetch.trigger: only when the exact source keyframe datagram is received from the live C++ producer
prefetch.visibility: source frame and timestamp must be <= live visible watermark, and image read begins after source publication
prefetch.availability: no active match, no active prefetch, no pending task; one worker shared, no extra thread/process
prefetch.priority: current-frame matching considered before prefetch; active prefetch is not preemptible; arriving matching during active prefetch follows original no-wait drop and is separately labelled
prefetch.skip: busy or unavailable source opportunity is recorded; no retries or later backfill
prefetch.work: existing Matcher.feature(source RGB) only; no target read, depth read, GPU matching, PnP, confidence or graph during prefetch
prefetch.partial_failure: failed prefetch acknowledged without pose correction; later matching uses original on-demand feature fallback

scope: Frozen offline comparison driven by the real C++ pose stream
